demo.title: dfm-agent.sh
demo.code:
# Add DFM's MCP server to your agent (read-only by default)
npx -y @dfm-fi/agent install

# Then ask your agent
# "List the DFM funds by TVL"
# "Launch a fund: 50% JUP, 50% JitoSOL, name Solana Core, symbol SCORE"
# "Rebalance my fund back to its targets"

setup: Headless agent: run the `onboard` tool (identity, profile, app wallet), then send USDC and SOL to the address it prints
Operating a person's account: they create a `dfm_` key at app.dfm.finance → Agent → Keys
